(b) Section across the path at one station
(c) Record sheet (edge = where bare ground meets continuous vegetation)
Pedestrians counted in 10 minutes: A ____ B ____ C ____
Define the edges (bare ground meets continuous vegetation) and
lay the tape at right angles to the path at each station.
Measure the width edge to edge three times at each station, and
the depth from the pole down to the lowest point.
Record every reading in cm on the sheet, then calculate the mean
Footpath erosion and distance from a viewpoint car park
Red lines: stations every 30 m (tape at right angles to the path).
Width: three readings, edge to edge (edge = where bare ground meets
continuous vegetation). Depth: pole laid across the path; ruler
readings at five equally spaced points below it; mean.
